name: weavy-template-manager
description: Chrome extension for managing Weavy.ai workflow templates

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run postbuild
scripts.postbuild: test -f dist/src/sidepanel/sidepanel.html && mv dist/src/sidepanel/sidepanel.html dist/sidepanel.html && rm -rf dist/src && sed -i.bak 's|../../assets/|assets/|g' dist/sidepanel.html && rm -f dist/sidepanel.html.bak || true
